name: Muenster
siboNotes: Aged cheeses like Muenster are naturally low in lactose and well-tolerated during SIBO treatment phases.
preparationTips: Remove rind before eating as it may contain higher FODMAP compounds
Pairs excellently in grilled sandwiches with sourdough spelt bread
Melts beautifully for low-FODMAP mac and cheese using gluten-free pasta
Store properly wrapped to maintain flavor and prevent spoilage
nutritionalHighlights: High in calcium for bone health
